description: Referenceable checklist of open work pulled from AI_HANDOFF.md (including its 2026-07-14 uncommitted entries), FEEL_AUDIT.md's Batch B/C backlog, and BUILDLOG.md's gamepad plan. Not a replacement for those files — this exists so nothing in the current open set gets silently dropped across sessions/tools. Tick items off by flipping status to 'done' and adding resolved_note + resolved_commit; keep finished items in the file for the record rather than deleting them.

tasks.title: Fix per-character leg/shin tilts to mirror with facing (knee detaches on turn)
tasks.source: AI_HANDOFF.md, Codex entry 2026-07-14 'knee connections break on facing changes'
tasks.detail: Skeleton.updateUpright's per-character _nearLegTilt/_nearShinTilt/_farLegTilt were screen-absolute while the true thighAng/shinAng bone chain mirrors with facing, so a knee tuned correctly in one facing detached in the other -- reproducible in the rig-tuner and in-game on turn. Both George and Thesz were affected.
tasks.resolved_note: Multiplied all three tilts by `facing` in Skeleton.js's updateUpright; `_farLegTilt` now also goes through the mirror it used to bypass when set. Existing tuned values are a no-op at facing=+1 (the tuning convention) and only change the previously-broken facing=-1 case. Verified: npm test 43/43, debug:play -- all 12/12, build clean, rig-tuner smoke.mjs 16/16, plus visual screenshots of both characters in both facings. Did NOT build the rig-tuner facing-toggle parity smoke check Codex's review suggested -- see rig-tuner-facing-parity-check below, split out as its own follow-up.
tasks.resolved_commit: uncommitted as of this entry -- see AI_HANDOFF.md 2026-07-14 (later) entry

tasks.title: Add a rig-tuner facing-toggle parity smoke check
tasks.source: AI_HANDOFF.md, Codex entry 2026-07-14 'knee connections break on facing changes' -- 'Add a rig-tuner smoke/parity check that toggles facing and compares the reflected transforms'
tasks.detail: Split out from mirrored-knee-tilt-fix, which fixed the underlying bug but verified it manually (screenshots) rather than adding an automated regression check. Would toggle facing in the rig-tuner harness and assert hip/knee/shin origins and rotations reflect across the wrestler centerline for both George and Thesz.
tasks.next_step: Not started. Lower priority now that the underlying bug is fixed -- would mainly guard against a future regression.

tasks.title: Art/cutter decision: remove the zero-margin knee-seam problem at the source
tasks.source: AI_HANDOFF.md, Claude entry 2026-07-14 'first live tuning session'
tasks.detail: The knee cap currently tucks with zero margin against the thigh's closed dark outline -- any future shin-down nudge re-exposes the seam. Two options parked for Derek: unlined overlap zone on the thigh's knee end, or a soft-faded shin cap (drawn or as a cutter post-processing step). Either removes the zero-margin fragility entirely instead of re-tuning around it every session.
tasks.next_step: First attempt (Sprite sheets/newLegLou/, 2026-07-15) tested through the real cutter pipeline; initial diagnosis (an ink line intruding into the shin's cap region) was WRONG -- Derek correctly suspected a pivot-crop mismatch instead. Confirmed: the cutter's pivotCrop step centers each part on its own top-row ink center, and the new thigh's pivot delta measured 21px different (source-canvas terms) from the working thigh's while the shin barely moved. Proven by test: re-applying the new art (ink line untouched) with legOffsetX nudged -15->-9 to compensate made the notch disappear completely. So any thigh redraw will need an offset retune regardless of art cleanliness -- the pivot is derived from ink shape, not a fixed marker. Nothing adopted yet -- reverted after the diagnostic test. Derek's call: adopt the new leg now with a legOffsetX retune (ink line and all -- it didn't visibly matter), wait for a cleaner shin redraw, or something else. See AI_HANDOFF.md 2026-07-15 '(later)' correction entry for full numbers.

tasks.title: Replace scissor-walk gait with a natural 4-phase walk + proximity-based wrestling shuffle
tasks.source: AI_HANDOFF.md, Codex entry 2026-07-14 'locomotion direction: replace scissor walk'
tasks.detail: Current open-ring walk reads as two straight legs scissoring through one hinge. Approved direction: open-ring gets a real 4-phase walk (contact / weight acceptance / bent-knee pass / extension) with the swing leg folding underneath the body; close range gets a guarded shorter wrestling shuffle (lead/rear stance, soft knees, small foot travel, no big centerline crossing); running/whip locomotion stays untouched. Blend lower-body gait intent through the existing combatBlend proximity seam rather than adding a new distance state; each leg adopts new gait params only during its own swing/footfall transition, not mid-plant (avoids skating).
tasks.next_step: mirrored-knee-tilt-fix is done; still blocked on lou-knee-art-cleanup landing first (per Codex's explicit recommended order) so the new gait isn't tuned against an art/rig bug that's about to change. Verification plan already specified: instrument planted-foot slip, capture both facings at contact/passing/extension, cross the full combatBlend range without pops, test stop/reverse/diagonal/crouched-close-range/entry-into-running, require Derek's playtest.

tasks.title: FEEL_AUDIT B2 -- contact-time hitstop and impact feedback
tasks.source: FEEL_AUDIT.md Batch B; AI_HANDOFF.md multiple entries name this as 'next per the brief's sequence'
tasks.detail: No hitstop exists anywhere; jab/headbutt have zero contact feedback. Add a small Arena-owned gameplay hitstop timer that gates _tickGame dt (ts-safe): jab ~35-45ms, headbutt/clothesline ~55-75ms, major landings ~80-110ms. Move knockdown camera shake from fall-complete to the actual contact frame; add a small shake to jab/headbutt.
tasks.next_step: Next in the core-feel-trio sequence after B1 (done) -- B2, then B3, per Codex's explicit brief.

tasks.title: FEEL_AUDIT B3 -- gravity-correct knockdown fall arcs
tasks.source: FEEL_AUDIT.md Batch B
tasks.detail: Falls currently rise fast (83ms) and float down slowly (284ms) -- anti-gravity, 1:3.4 rise:fall ratio measured. Replace with a two-phase arc: ~35-45% duration accelerating-ease-out rise, ~55-65% accelerating-ease-in descent, landing at speed, horizontal travel finishing at or just before touchdown. Preserve all existing ring clamps (Batch A).
tasks.next_step: Third of the core feel trio, after B1 (done) and B2.

tasks.title: FEEL_AUDIT B4 -- momentum-scaled knockback
tasks.source: FEEL_AUDIT.md Batch B
tasks.detail: Knockback distance should scale with victim speed at contact (standing x1, whipped runner x~2); rebound clothesline/axe-handle drain x1.4 on running victims. Currently momentum isn't conserved and running hits no harder than standing hits.
tasks.next_step: After the B1-B3 core trio lands and is re-measured; implement after B2/B3 per Codex's sequencing note ('implement after the basic velocity and fall models stabilize').

tasks.next_step: Same sequencing tier as B4/B6 -- after the core trio.

tasks.title: FEEL_AUDIT B6 -- per-wrestler mass

tasks.next_step: Same sequencing tier as B4/B5 -- after the core trio. Touches several interconnected systems, do last within Batch B per Codex's note.

tasks.title: FEEL_AUDIT C1 -- kickout depth tracks damage
tasks.source: FEEL_AUDIT.md Batch C; confirmed still untouched by the 2026-07-11 post-Thesz-press baseline (91-100% count-1 kickouts across both matchups)
tasks.detail: Replace the binary first-press-escape with a continuous per-press success curve so covers on a 70-stamina wrestler break at 1, 40-stamina at 2, 20-stamina at 2.7+ -- while fresh wrestlers never die to a cheap cover. Currently 91-100% of kickouts happen at count 1 with zero nearfalls in most matchups.
tasks.next_step: Derek owns the booking-tuning call (thresholds/curve shape); Claude implements once direction is set. C1 is one of the two 'drama pair' items Codex called out as highest priority within Batch C.

tasks.title: FEEL_AUDIT C2 -- kill the zombie phase / redesign finish-hunting
tasks.source: FEEL_AUDIT.md Batch C + the 2026-07-11 post-Thesz-press baseline finding
tasks.detail: Original C2 design (AI hunts the finish once opponent's standing stamina drops below ~15) is confirmed dead on arrival: George is standing below 60 stamina in 0.3% of trace samples and below 42 in 0.0% -- the 'standing opponent below threshold' state the finishers gate on essentially never occurs, because taunt regen (~35/match) and kickout refunds lift him back over every threshold before he's upright. Must instead catch the down/getting-up window directly, or suppress the recovery stack (taunt conversion + kickout refunds) once a wrestler has been driven under the threshold, or both.
tasks.next_step: Derek weighs in on the redesigned trigger (down-window vs. recovery-stack suppression vs. both) -- explicitly flagged in the handoff as needing his input before implementation.

tasks.title: FEEL_AUDIT C3 -- escalation gates on big moves + diminishing repetition heat
tasks.source: FEEL_AUDIT.md Batch C
tasks.detail: AI shouldn't throw piledriver/sleeper/top-tier moves before damage+heat justify them (e.g. piledriver odds ~0 until opponent <55 stamina or heat >45, ramping after); pair with per-move diminishing heat (bump x 0.65^(uses in last 60s)) so spamming a move stops paying. Currently finishers can open a match at 0:05 and repeat up to 35 times with no penalty.
tasks.next_step: After C1/C2 land and are re-measured, per Codex's stated order.

tasks.title: FEEL_AUDIT C4 -- fights use the ring (recenter after wall knockdowns)
tasks.source: FEEL_AUDIT.md Batch C
tasks.detail: After downing an opponent at the ropes, AI should reposition to the open side; slams/whips delivered at a wall should aim the throw toward ring center. A1 (already shipped) restored the whip counter, which does part of this job already.
tasks.next_step: After C1-C3, per Codex's stated order.

tasks.title: Wire up gamepad support (mapping exists, never connected to Arena)
tasks.source: BUILDLOG.md 'NEXT SESSION: gamepad support' entry; confirmed still true via MOVES.md:15 and PRD.md:205
tasks.detail: input.gamepad plugin is enabled and InputHandler.js already has a full gamepad branch (A=grapple, B=run, X=power, Y=finisher, LB=evade, RB=block, d-pad + left stick 0.4 deadzone) -- but Arena never constructs a 'gamepad' InputHandler, so none of it has ever executed. Six-step plan already written: (1) verify actual Phaser 4 gamepad Button API (.pressed/.value, no built-in justDown -- needs per-frame edge detection), (2) press-any-button pad assignment (pad0 -> current keyboard player, pad1 -> the other), (3) extend the 1/2 mode-toggle cycle to include a GAMEPAD state + handle disconnect, (4) unlock audio on first gamepad button press too, (5) real-controller playtest as the primary check, (6) optionally inject a fake navigator.getGamepads for headless debug:play coverage.
tasks.next_step: Not started. Flagged repeatedly as 'the strongest parallel product/accessibility task' that can run alongside the feel-batch work without touching the same systems.

tasks.title: Historical announcer commentary system -- 50-clip pilot
tasks.source: AI_HANDOFF.md, entry on pre-generated commentary audio (~line 780)
tasks.detail: Approved future direction, not implemented: pre-generated (not live-TTS) commentary clips, event/intensity/match-phase-tagged, fetched lazily post audio-unlock gesture (full 300-clip library as decoded Web Audio buffers would run ~250MB RAM), one active voice at a time with per-line/category cooldowns, ducked under the synthesized crowd. Data shape: stable ID, transcript, event type, intensity, valid match phases, wrestler/venue applicability, factual source/review status, cooldown, asset path. Recommended: ship a 50-clip pilot before scaling to the full ~300.
